name: Thinkly Capture
description: Turn OpenClaw chats into a reusable wiki and knowledge graph.

apiUrl.label: Thinkly API URL
apiUrl.help: Required. Set the Thinkly API base URL before /clip or /ingest can run.

apiKey.label: Thinkly API Key
apiKey.help: Required for new setups. Scoped API key used to send clips and ingests to Thinkly.

apiToken.label: Legacy API Token
apiToken.help: Legacy fallback if you do not have an API key yet. Prefer apiKey for new setups.

transportMode.label: Transport mode
transportMode.help: Choose which Thinkly endpoint receives saved data. Use legacy_highlights for compatibility, or agent_api_v1 to test the newer Agent API path.

llm.apiKey.label: LLM API Key
llm.apiKey.help: Optional. If set with llm.provider and llm.model, message text may be sent to the LLM provider for intent parsing and high-confidence auto-execution.

llm.provider.label: LLM Provider
llm.provider.help: Optional. Used only with llm.model and llm.apiKey to enable external intent parsing. Example: openai

llm.model.label: LLM Model
llm.model.help: Optional. Used only with llm.provider and llm.apiKey for external intent parsing. Example: gpt-4.1-mini
